g.title: crate Expose Astryx Neutral as an official Kivact UI kit.
crate::alert_dialog Compose alert confirmation with the standard modal behavior.
crate::app_shell Arrange responsive Neutral navigation around application content.
crate::aspect_ratio Keep content clipped to a specified aspect ratio.
crate::avatar Display a person's photo, initials, or silhouette with optional status.
crate::avatar_group Lay out overlapping avatars and manage their keyboard navigation.
crate::avatar_group_overflow Show the number of people omitted from a facepile.
crate::avatar_options Share Avatar sizes and silhouettes across the avatar family.
crate::avatar_status_dot Draw presence indicators and report their labels to the containing avatar.
crate::banner Neutral feedback banners with optional details and dismissal.
crate::blockquote Present a quotation and optional attribution with a logical start rule.
crate::bottom_sheet Present a bottom-aligned sheet with draggable detents.
crate::breadcrumbs Render a named, wrapping Neutral breadcrumb trail.
crate::button_group Joined Neutral action buttons with roving keyboard focus.
crate::calendar Soft calendar and its single-date and range selection surfaces.
crate::card Render the Neutral card surface and propagate its content insets.
crate::carousel Render a horizontal Neutral carousel with measured scroll controls.
crate::choice_list Labelled rows of checkbox and radio options.
crate::citation Present a document source as an inline label or numbered citation.
crate::code Display an inline code fragment in the Neutral monospace treatment.
crate::code_block Render syntax-highlighted code with line and copy controls.
crate::collapsible Render Neutral disclosure triggers and coordinate groups.
crate::color Define the Astryx Neutral palette for light and dark appearances.
crate::container_reveal Reveal in-place actions on hover and keyboard focus.
crate::date_input Typed date field and its attached calendar.
crate::date_range_input Date range field and its two-month popover.
crate::date_time_input Combined local date and wall-clock time editor.
crate::date_touch Adaptive date/time sheet surfaces and direct-manipulation picker wheels.
crate::dialog_header Lay out Soft dialog and drawer headings.
crate::divider Draw the Neutral separator and its optional label.
crate::elevation Apply Neutral surface elevation to a style.
crate::empty_state Present a centered empty-state title, description, and actions.
crate::feedback Render badges, loading placeholders, and status indicators.
crate::field_status Present an attached or detached field validation message.
crate::file_input Select or drop native paths and validate them before publishing.
crate::form_layout Arrange fields with Neutral form spacing.
crate::grid Provide Neutral grid tracks and item spans.
crate::heading Provide semantic headings with the Neutral heading or display typography.
crate::hover_card Attach a delayed nonmodal preview to a trigger.
crate::icon Render themed icons with Neutral sizing and optional color.
crate::icons Embed the pinned Lucide SVGs used by Astryx Neutral.
crate::indicator Presentational checkbox, radio, and check marks for caller-owned semantics.
crate::input_group Join independently framed form controls in one labelled row.
crate::kbd Display a parsed keyboard shortcut as a sequence of key caps.
crate::layout Define responsive application layout insets.
crate::lightbox Display images in a modal gallery with captions and zoom.
crate::link Neutral text links with explicit native activation.
crate::markdown Render Markdown blocks and inline marks with Neutral components.
crate::markdown_parser Parse Markdown blocks without adding dependencies to the kit.
crate::media_overlay Layer actions or labels within the bounds of their media.
crate::media_query Read responsive breakpoints from the viewport and measured containers.
crate::mobile_nav Render the responsive Neutral navigation drawer and its toggle.
crate::month_swipe Inline swipe ownership and month snapping for the touch calendar.
crate::more_menu Attach a Neutral action menu to a compact overflow trigger.
crate::nav_heading Render navigation headings and their shared keyboard-operated menus.
crate::nav_icon Display a round accent icon for navigation headings.
crate::outline Track visible document headings and navigate their outline.
crate::pagination Render one-based pagination with Neutral controls and a moving page window.
crate::pagination::tests Verify page-window boundary and gap rules.
crate::power_search Compose named search filters with an explicit editor and remove controls.
crate::recipe_style Share Neutral transitions, outlines and composited control fills.
crate::recipes Cache the standard component recipe table for the Soft theme.
crate::recipes_collections Neutral recipes for standard navigation, split panes and collections.
crate::recipes_controls Style the standard Soft action controls and register their recipes.
crate::recipes_controls_choice Style the persistent indicator parts of Soft choice controls.
crate::recipes_controls_value Style Soft sliders and progress bars using their standard value parts.
crate::recipes_dialog Style the standard dialog kinds and share overlay paint helpers.
crate::recipes_field Style the native editors, field text, and composite input frames for Soft.
crate::recipes_menu Style the standard dropdown, context and submenu parts.
crate::recipes_popup Style the standard tooltip and notification region.
crate::recipes_popup_command Style the standard command palette and its native search field.
crate::recipes_select Style the standard select trigger, popup, and option rows for Soft.
crate::resizable Resize and optionally collapse a Neutral layout panel.
crate::rich_block_doc Preserve Markdown source ranges while editing visual blocks.
crate::rich_block_doc::tests Verify unedited bytes survive block edits and movement.
crate::rich_blocks Edit source-preserving Markdown blocks using native wrapped text fields.
crate::rich_text Source-preserving Markdown editing and a formatted read-only preview.
crate::rich_text::tests Verify the editor preserves Markdown source.
crate::scrollable_area Add a named, keyboard-accessible Neutral scroll viewport.
crate::section Draw a full-bleed Neutral section and propagate content spacing.
crate::segmented_control The Neutral segmented radio presentation.
crate::selector Single and multiple option selection and custom selector popovers.
crate::shadows Resolve Astryx Neutral elevation and inset shadows.
crate::side_nav Render Neutral sidebar navigation, nested items and its collapsed rail.
crate::soft_chat Neutral chat messages, lists, and scroll layout.
crate::soft_chat_composer Composer controls for application-owned chat state.
crate::soft_chat_tools Chat tools, token display and grapheme-safe streaming text.
crate::soft_list Static lists and neutral item rows.
crate::soft_metadata Key-value metadata arranged in a neutral grid.
crate::soft_table Static table elements and presentation helpers for the standard DataTable.
crate::soft_tree Neutral tree list over Kivact's public tree interaction.
crate::spinner Neutral loading spinner and its shared arc paint.
crate::stack Provide Astryx spacing and flex layout primitives.
crate::stepper Render Neutral progress steps and a width-sensitive summary.
crate::tab_list Render Neutral tabs, manual keyboard selection and overflow menus.
crate::text Render themed body, supporting, code, and display text.
crate::theme Install the Astryx Neutral tokens and recipes on the Kivact theme.
crate::theme_access Read the Soft tokens of the active theme.
crate::theme_scope Scope Neutral media contrast and syntax palettes to a subtree.
crate::thumbnail Preview an image attachment with upload, open, and remove affordances.
crate::time_input Typed wall-clock time, independent of time zone.
crate::time_of_day Validated wall-clock time independent of any picker surface.
crate::timer Display the elapsed time since a wall-clock instant.
crate::timestamp Format timestamps as calendar dates, wall-clock times, or relative ages.
crate::toggle_button_group Group independently tabbable Neutral toggle buttons.
crate::token Neutral entity tokens with independently operable removal.
crate::tokenizer Choose and remove unique tokens from a keyed suggestion source.
crate::tokens Expose the spacing, typography, motion and color tokens of Astryx Neutral.
crate::toolbar Neutral toolbar layout, shared roving focus and keyboard hints.
crate::top_nav Render desktop and mobile Neutral top navigation and its menus.
crate::typeahead Searchable keyed suggestions with a native editor and an anchored list.
crate::visually_hidden Expose noninteractive text to assistive technology without painting it.
